name: Washed Ashore
summary: Along Darkshore, sea creatures are washing ashore in growing numbers. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde studies the deaths from Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where priestesses fear the strandings may be an ill omen.

sections.title: A Disturbing Omen
sections.body: Great sea creatures have sometimes beached themselves on Darkshore. It is a tragic sight, but it has been occasional. Now they wash ashore in growing numbers along the coast. The Priestesses of Elune in the Temple of the Moon fear these deaths may bring ill omens to northern Kalimdor.

sections.title: Scavengers of the Shallows
sections.body: The Temple of the Moon sends scholar Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde to the port town of Auberdine to learn why the great beasts come ashore. Based there, she gathers biological samples to send by hippogryph to Darnassus for close examination. Greymist murlocs swarm the carcasses in the surf, scavenging the remains. Without armed protection, researchers cannot reach the bones.

faq.q: Why are giant sea creatures washing up on Darkshore?
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon is still investigating why giant sea creatures wash ashore on Darkshore. Such strandings happen now and then, but their sudden increase has led night elf scholars to fear a deeper disturbance or ill omen beneath the Great Sea.

Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is an investigator sent from Darnassus by the Temple of the Moon. Based in Auberdine, she catalogs coastal anomalies and collects samples from beached leviathans to send to the priesthood for study.

faq.q: Where does the creature south of Auberdine lie?
faq.answer: The creature's bones lie on the shoreline a short march south of the Auberdine docks. Greymist murlocs surround the great carcass in the surf and guard it.

faq.q: What will Darnassus do with the sea creature bones?
faq.answer: Hippogryphs carry the bones directly to Darnassus. Scholars and priestesses at the Temple of the Moon study the marrow, structure, and signs of decay to learn whether disease, foul magic, or unnatural predation drove the beast ashore.

faq.q: Why are the Greymist murlocs gathered around the carcass?
faq.answer: The Greymist murlocs use the stranded giants as an easy source of food, tools, and bonecraft. They claim the carcasses, making an unarmed approach life-threatening for scholars.

faq.q: Does this investigation conclude after retrieving the first set of bones?
faq.answer: No. The carcass south of town is the first site. Gwennyth continues her research with further inquiries into other leviathans that have died along Darkshore's long, mist-shrouded coast.

angles.text: The coastal strandings disturb Darkshore's balance. The Sisterhood of Elune intervenes directly from Darnassus.
As a priest, you know the Sisterhood of Elune must read spiritual omens and natural imbalances. Gwennyth seeks to decipher those signs in the sea creature's remains.
As a druid, you can read the mass death of marine life as a warning of ecological discord along the Kalimdor coast, one that calls for watchful attention.
